extracted.intended_audience: VA clinicians and researchers (current or prospective) seeking VA ORD funding
extracted.subtask_description: Official Office of Research & Development (ORD) web page listing resources, requirements, and procedural guidance for preparing and submitting research proposals to VA (intramural) funding. Emphasizes eligibility, submission channels, and internal resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on Veterans' needs
rubrics_metrics.description: VA Research is the only research program focused entirely on Veterans' needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects funded by VA ORD should center Veterans' needs and priorities; the program's mission is explicitly Veteran-focused.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intramural eligibility (VA employees only)
rubrics_metrics.description: VA Research is intramural, meaning only VA employees can conduct research under VA's sponsorship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal investigators and those conducting VA-sponsored research must be VA employees. Typical collaborations with external academic partners are allowed but the sponsored research itself is intramural.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typical collaboration with academic institutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Typically, VA researchers collaborate with academic institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collaboration with academic partners is common and is described as an exceptional benefit that helps identify direct patient needs and move discoveries to care; applicants should plan partnerships accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: High clinician representation among investigators
rubrics_metrics.description: More than 60 percent of VA researchers are also clinicians who provide direct patient care.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The prevalence of clinician-investigators is highlighted as enabling rapid translation of research to clinical care and as a recruitment advantage; this contextual expectation may influence team composition and project framing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic submission via Grants.gov
rubrics_metrics.guidance: VA ORD directs applicants to submit proposals electronically through Grants.gov; applicants should follow Grants.gov procedures and any VA-specific e-submission instructions linked from ORD.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Proposal Guidance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should consult the ORD 'Proposal Guidance' resource for detailed instructions on preparing applications (the page lists this resource link for specifics).

rubrics_metrics.name: Respond to ISRM NOSIs and RFAs when applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: ISRM Notices of Special Interest (NOSIs) and Requests for Applications (RFAs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should monitor and respond to ISRM NOSIs and RFAs posted by ORD/ISRM when their work aligns with those specific solicitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Just-in-Time (JIT) process and RPPR reporting (intranet access)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on Just-in-Time (JIT) Process to Release Funds and Federal-wide Research Performance Progress Report can be found on the intranet at https://vaww.research.va.gov/funding/default.cfm (If you have VA network access, copy and paste the URL into your browser.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details about JIT fund release and RPPR (reporting) procedures are available on the VA intranet and require VA network access; applicants and awardees must follow those internal procedures for fund release and progress reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required forms and position classification (Form 4670)
rubrics_metrics.description: Forms 4670 - Position Classification Worksheet for Research Positions (VA network access only). Additional forms are available on the VHA's database of electronic forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certain administrative forms (e.g., 4670 Position Classification Worksheet) are required for VA research positions and are available on VA internal systems; applicants should complete required forms per instructions and note some resources require VA network access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use central office contacts and publication notification resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Resources: Central Office Contacts; Publication Notification for Investigators; Policies and Guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and investigators should use central office contact points for questions, follow ORD policies and guidance, and comply with publication notification processes as described in the listed resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult 'How to join VA’s Research' plain-language guide
rubrics_metrics.description: See also: How to join VA’s Research: A Plain-Language Guide for Research Scientists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective investigators should review the plain-language guide to understand distinctions of VA research (eligibility, intramural nature, and other differences from other federal research programs) before applying.
